कूज् {c1c} P. (कूजति, कूजित)
1 To
make any inarticulate sound, hum,
coo, warble; कूजंतं राम रामेति मधुरं
मधुराक्षरं Rām.; पुंस्कोकिलो यन्मधुरं चुकूज

.
--2 To moan, groan.
--3 To
fill with sounds. --WITH नि, परि, or
वि to coo, to make an indistinct
noise.
